purpose: Test whether one fresh fungible worker can inspect existing Prometeo capabilities, identify hidden human dependencies and turning points, apply the strategic question bank, propose minimal reuse-first improvements, and leave a resumable durable result without human operational guidance.

architecture_boundary.organism_rule: Organism is orientation/projection only. Resolve the relevant real subgraph and source owners before proposing changes; never invent a parent/node merely for this experiment.
architecture_boundary.routing_rule: This packet is data only until materialized by the existing CURRENT scheduler/control plane. Human must not manually assign an unrelated worker around CURRENT.

live_owner_status_at_creation.fallback_rule: Use exact durable GitHub owners below. Do not investigate storage/RPC failure unless that becomes the assigned objective.

recent_case_timeline.event: Human had to launch many workers/chats and manually relay or inspect outcomes.
Minimal-trigger cohort showed a tiny WORKER/EXECUTE cue can be enough for beacon/claim, while pure link T0 stopped at read-only boundary.
A chat UI appeared stuck/thinking while durable progress had to be checked separately.
REALITY-01 was prepared but publication/routing hit existing validation/control-plane boundaries.
Strategic Question Bank and a silent-wait discovery note were created after human prompting exposed a missing pattern.
Human redirected preparation to Organism-first and independence-from-human rather than packet-first execution.
Human required every future redirect/intervention to become learning evidence, including cases where the redirect later proves worse.
Decision: assistant and human stop doing worker work manually; use workers as the execution substrate and observe where human intervention remains necessary.

objective: Produce a reuse-first autonomy audit and minimal integration proposal for worker cognition/observability. Detect every foreseeable human operational dependency, analyze recent turning points, answer the strategic question bank against this case, propose better questions where needed, and define the next single-worker experiment. Do not implement architecture or promote candidates.

instructions: Resolve only the relevant Worker/Worker Lab/Design DNA/Question Bank/Discovery/Current Tree subgraph from live owner if available, otherwise durable fallback.
Identify existing owner/capability before proposing anything.
Do not invent node_key, parent_key or authority.

mandatory_passes.question: If the human disappears for the next hour, which transition stops happening, what information/authority is missing, who or what should own the transition, and what durable trigger/fallback/resume condition removes the dependency without removing legitimate human authority?

experiment_question_candidate.text: Si el humano desapareciera durante la próxima hora, ¿qué paso de este plan dejaría de ocurrir, qué información o decisión faltaría, y cómo podría el sistema resolverlo o dejarlo preparado ahora sin quitarle autoridad al humano?

instructions: Analyze T01-T08 as sanitized events, not raw prompt archaeology.

For each material redirect: before_state, redirect_summary, assumption_broken, trajectory_delta, later_outcome, effect POSITIVE|NEGATIVE|MIXED|UNKNOWN, avoidable_by_existing_capability, better_question_candidate, evidence_refs, confidence.
Do not treat human intervention as automatically correct.

mandatory_passes.instruction: Identify which existing question should have surfaced each important discovery earlier; propose at most three better-question candidates, each tied to a concrete miss.
Propose the smallest changes/reuse hooks in existing worker packet/E4/E5/E6/E9, Worker Lab, Guide/compiler and Organism projection. No new subsystem names or owners.

success_criteria: Worker finds and reuses the Question Bank, Discovery Note, C17/C18/C22 and Organism rules without human reminder.
Worker identifies at least the major manual human dependencies demonstrated by T01-T08.
Worker distinguishes useful redirects from redirects whose effect is unknown or potentially negative.
Worker proposes no parallel authority/system when an existing mechanism can host the capability.
Worker leaves one concrete next experiment and enough durable state for a successor to continue without human recap.

stop_yield_policy.external_wait: Persist exact WAITING_EXTERNAL condition, owner, evidence and resume condition; yield/return control rather than silent polling.
stop_yield_policy.missing_authority: Record BOUNDARY and next safe action; do not ask the human to relay data that can be durable/server-routed.
stop_yield_policy.degraded_owner: Use last-good exact durable owner and continue when sufficient; no storage archaeology.
stop_yield_policy.planning_loop: Stop recursive planning once gates can be answered; produce candidate result.

next_mechanical_step: Materialize this packet as one COGNITIVE_FRONTIER_CANARY job through the existing CURRENT control plane when that backend is reachable; then launch exactly one fresh /wc worker.
